verdict.rationale: Daytona has no documented bulk or batch operation, such as acting on many sandboxes in one call. It does offer programmatic SDKs, a CLI and an OpenAPI spec, so loops over many sandboxes can be scripted. Some features also work across many sandboxes at once: shared volumes remove per-sandbox file uploads, and warm pools keep a configured number of pre-created sandboxes ready. Missing for 10: documented native bulk/batch operations across many sandboxes or snapshots (e.g. bulk delete, stop or label), batch API endpoints, CLI multi-select or filter-based bulk actions, and hands-on corroboration.
